description: Returns the status of an SOS Flights case by its case code: whether it is active, the team's recommended solution once there is one, the last 10 chat messages for chat cases, and the case page link.

case_code.description: 8-character case code from the payment confirmation or case page, for example 53039309.

lang.description: Language of the case page link. Defaults to en.

name: sos_get_case
title: Get case status
